title: Bugfix Stratoshark dissector dependencies
description:
Some additional "generic media" dissectors should be included and some of the JSON dependent dissectors should only be called if there is "packet support" (i.e. NOT Stratoshark)

Fixes 3c1f18defd32b8be2576630b6a5c3bc2bbf8e9a6

The "OOPS" messages should now be addressed.

For the "deprecated_port_pref(): ..." message: What preference file are you using?  In my "installed" version of Stratoshark I don't have a preference file with obvious "protocol preferences".  But in my development environment, I have seen similar issues where I contend it's loading/using a "Wireshark file" instead of a "Stratoshark" file.

The OOPSes are gone, thanks! If I rename `~/.config/stratoshark` to  `~/.config/stratoshark.save` the prefs warnings go away, but they remain if I try to rename the top-level preference file or any profile preference files. It might just be specific to my system.

I don't think it's just your system, but these changes (along with 3c1f18de) will make it more obvious when Wireshark configuration/files are being used for Stratoshark.  I still have issues with Stratoshark trying to run Wireshark plugins (because they are all in the same build output directory).
